 To connect to your LinkAce server, tap the triple dots menu in the top right, then Settings . In the Server section specify your server address in a http[s]://<address>[:<port>]/ format and then paste the API token from your LinkAce dashboard into the API key field.

Weather Magic PWS puts your own personal weather station on your iPhone. It reads the data your station already sends to Weathercloud and shows your readings as they come in. You can also connect your own station's Weather Underground account (optional).
If your station goes offline, Weather Magic PWS can use a nearby backup station so you still see current conditions until your station is back.
FREE
- Live data from your home station
- Today's graphs
- One backup station
Free does not include long-term history, cloud storage or data export.
PRO: ONE UNLOCK FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription. Buy it once and it unlocks Pro on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. On iPhone and iPad you can try Pro free for 30 days first, once; the trial never renews or charges. Pro adds:
- Your station's history and week, month and year graphs, read from your own cloud database. Long-range graphs load quickly because they use hourly and daily averages.
- Your own cloud database: choose Turso or Supabase and connect an account you control
- Multiple devices: one computer, such as your Mac, collects your station's data every minute. If it stops, another computer takes over automatically. Your iPhone and iPad view the data from the cloud.
- A second backup station
- Air quality
- Near-real-time lightning: the wind vane shows nearby strikes on 1, 5, 10 and 20 mile rings with a flashing bolt. On iPhone and iPad, lightning comes from your collecting computer through your cloud database, so no key is needed here.
- Data export
YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Your station's data goes only to your own database. It is not sent to us. Data read from public backup stations is used only in the app and is never pushed back to its source.
GOOD TO KNOW
- Weather Magic PWS is built for owners of a personal weather station that sends its data to Weathercloud. Connecting your own station's Weather Underground account is optional.
- Viewing history from the cloud needs Pro, your own Turso or Supabase account, and a computer running Weather Magic PWS to collect your station's data.
- Lightning data is provided by OpenWeather and requires a free OpenWeather account and API key on your collecting computer. Pro setup there walks you through creating one. No key is needed if your weather station reports lightning itself.
- Air quality and lightning depend on the data available for your area.
- Readings come from your station and the sources you connect, and may sometimes be delayed or unavailable.

firefox-addons:2992325.name: Tab Focus
firefox-addons:2992325.summary: Prevent selected tabs from detecting when you switch away.
firefox-addons:2992325.description:
Tab Focus is a browser extension that prevents websites from knowing when you switch away from their tab. When enabled on a tab, it intercepts all tab-switch detection methods used by pages: the Page Visibility API, visibilitychange events, blur and focus events, pagehide, and animation frame throttling. The page always sees itself as visible and focused, no matter what you are actually doing.
You can enable protection per tab with a single click or hotkey, choose between three spoofing modes (full, visibility only, or focus only), and set auto-disable timers. Auto-rules let you protect specific sites automatically every time they load, and tab groups let you enable protection across a set of sites at once. A clean popup gives you a live view of all open tabs, rule management with wildcard pattern matching, import and export, and a stats panel tracking usage over time.

apple-macos:6753728022.description:
Note: This app requires SessionDock for macOS to sync and view your sessions.
SessionDock Companion – View Your Sessions Anywhere
SessionDock Companion lets you browse your SessionDock sessions from your Mac, right on your iPhone.
Quickly view your projects, notes, and metadata in a clean, read-only interface. The Companion app is designed for safe reference—no editing, tagging, or changes—so your desktop library always stays intact.
New in this version: Waveform Notes Viewer
See timestamped notes directly on your mixdown waveform. Tap “Show Notes” to reveal markers that highlight in sync with playback, and use the Session Notes list below to jump to any moment. It’s a powerful way to review your creative thoughts while listening on the go.
Key Features
• View all sessions saved from the desktop app
• Preview session audio/mixdown. 
• Read project names, notes, and metadata
• Fast, lightweight, and read-only
• Keeps your creative catalog consistent and secure
• CarPlay support — browse and play session previews hands-free while driving
SessionDock Companion makes it easy to stay connected to your music projects wherever you go.

apple-macos:6476817859.name: Sabertooth for Mastodon
apple-macos:6476817859.description:
Sabertooth puts the power of the fediverse social network in your hand. Access a universe of user-created content and join the decentralized conversation from anywhere.
Connect with friends near and far by following users across instance boundaries. Share your perspective through photos, videos, and short-form posting. Discover new voices and communities by exploring public timelines.
Customize your experience with content warnings, muting, and blocking. Stay in control of your digital life. Harness the strength of open protocols and ethical design.
Sabertooth allows you to tap into the fediverse and join the Mastodon social network through an intuitive, cross-device experience. The future of social media, in your hand.
What is the Fediverse?
The fediverse is a network of decentralized, interoperable social media servers. Each server runs open source software that implements shared protocols like ActivityPub. This enables users on different servers to follow each other and interact across the fediverse.
